name: The Writhing Deep
summary: In the Writhing Deep, Raschal has gone to investigate a grave danger to Feralas. Your search for him leads there.

sections.title: The Note in the Packs
sections.body: The backpacks hold a parcel for Thalanaar and a hurried note with no recipient named. Raschal of Feathermoon wrote it after finding bug-like creatures in the Writhing Deep, south of the gnoll camps. He feared they threatened all of Feralas, so he went to investigate them himself. His note shows where he went.

sections.title: What Waits Below
sections.body: Below the Writhing Deep, you find a large pod of an alien kind. Its mucous surface bears hardened growths, and it is broad and tall enough to hold a person. Through its skin, you can make out the faint shape of a humanoid inside.

faq.answer: Raschal of Feathermoon wrote the note found in the backpacks. He went to investigate bug-like creatures he had discovered, and your search for him continues.

faq.q: Where is the Writhing Deep located?
faq.answer: Raschal's note places the Writhing Deep south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

faq.q: Why did Raschal go to the Writhing Deep?
aliases: why raschal went to the hive
faq.answer: Raschal wrote that he found insidious bug-like creatures there and felt he had to investigate them himself. He feared they threatened all of Feralas.
The search follows The Woodpaw Gnolls, the step before it.
